842840 - Escalators and moving walkways (commercial and heavy-duty escalators)

product_summary: Manufacturer of lifts and escalators, Chennai (Tamil Nadu). Website (johnsonliftsltd.com, homepage) lists: residential lifts (individual homes/villas, residential apartments, high-rise apartments); commercial lifts (hospitals, offices, hotels, IT parks, malls & retail, factory/industry); escalators (commercial, heavy-duty); plus service/modernisation and lift safety components (over-speed governor, safety gear, door sensors, door closures, hoistway door locks, pit buffers, limit switches, cartop inspection assembly). Own manufacturing: lift factories at Vyasarpadi, Ambattur, Poonamallee, Nagpur, Sengadu; escalator plant at Oragadam, Chennai since 2010; 155 ft test tower; claims BIS/IS17900 and EN81 certification. Overseas presence pages for Bhutan, Bahrain, Maldives, Nepal, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Sri Lanka, Tanzania, UAE, Uganda, Qatar.
comment: HS 842840 (escalators/moving walkways) is CORRECT and fully corroborated by the company's own product line - commercial and heavy-duty escalators, in-house escalator plant at Oragadam since 2010. HS 843131 (parts of lifts/escalators) is also correct but only partially covers the range: the company's main output is complete lifts, which fall under 842810 (lifts and skip hoists), and that code is MISSING from the declaration. Recommended correction: 842810 + 842840 + 843131 (optionally 853080 for the EyeRIS/WATCH control and IoT devices). So: partial match, code needs completion, not rejection (Rule 3). Industry misclassification: declared as 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) - WRONG. This is mechanical engineering / vertical-transport equipment manufacturing (elevator & escalator industry); the 'factory/industry lifts' product line is a customer segment, not a mining activity. Trader signs: none - own factories, own R&D, own test tower, own service network; manufacturer role confirmed. Product lines missing from the declaration: complete passenger/goods lifts (842810), lift modernisation/service (no HS, service), IoT/contactless call devices (853080/853010). Note on the legal name: the website brands itself both 'Johnson Lifts Pvt Ltd' (blog text) and 'Johnson Lifts Ltd' (header/footer) - the entity-name discrepancy is outside my HS scope and not verified here. All product claims above are from the company website only; no customs line was available to me in this task, therefore the specific export/import flows are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (overseas market pages exist but are not shipment evidence).
